description:
Split from fz-sc8.176 (item 2).

A record's convergence class keeps every field (Types::convergence_class and convergence_class_at, the sole_record branch), so two structs passed where no use reads them still get separate keys, in recursive and non-recursive bodies alike. No reason is recorded for keeping the fields.

The original symptom (Kernel.panic/1 and fz_panic/1 keyed once per exception type on the distiller) is gone at base: as of fz-sc8.176 the distiller activates neither, under interp or build. Find a current fixture where an unasked struct splits a key before changing anything.

Open, each answered by an experiment:
- What the class is: keep __struct__ and drop the fields, or the map class.
- Whether two structs merged under one key change their runtime lane (value_lane_repr types maps exactly). Check against the transport code and a native run.

Acceptance: suite census (scratchpad census tooling: applied jobs, shift wakes, withdrawals) shows no rise in withdrawals and a net fall; matrix passes on all three paths; every pin move attributed.
title: A record nothing asks about keys by its class, not by every field
